cta.mailBody:
Hi,

I'd like to reserve a seat.

What I'm building:

seat.title: Reserve a seat
seat.lede: We build for two founders a week. Leave your email and we write to you when a seat opens.
seat.error: Enter the email address we should write to.
seat.next1: Now: an email with what you get, what it costs and what happens next.
seat.next2: When a seat opens: we write to you, and a deposit confirms it.
seat.next3: Then: one 30-minute call, and sign-up, payments and team accounts are working within 48 hours.
seat.small: We use your email for your seat and nothing else.
seat.doneText: We sent the details to {email}. If nothing arrives in a few minutes, look in your spam folder or write to hello@fonderiejs.com.
